summary_1line: Indra questions Yayati, whose pride causes his fall from heaven; he asks to fall among the virtuous and is encountered by the sage Ashtaka.

image_candidates.scene_text: Yayati, radiant like the sun, plunges from the heavens while astonished sages gaze upward from the earth below.
Indra seated on his celestial throne confronts Yayati in the luminous court of the gods after hearing the king's boast.
The sage Ashtaka and other ascetics look skyward as the glowing figure of Yayati descends through the clouds like a falling star.
